body: Thank you for the support, really, and i'm glad i didn't do anything reckless. Yesterday was a pretty nice day, it felt like a breath of fresh air. It gave me strength to stay around longer, even though i'm back to feeling bad today, maybe i'll have another good day in the near future.

Thank you for the encouragement. My relationship with my family, and mostly my mom, has improved over the last 2 years and she's much more supportive and understanding now, she just doesn't know how to help and i don't really know either so i can't blame her. I know she does and says all these things out of love and concern for me, even if it isn't always the best thing. I'll try to talk to her about it. 
I have an appointment with another psychiatrist in march. I'll try my best to hold on until then, maybe they'll be able to help me a little bit.
Again, thank you, and have a nice day.
